title: The Landlord Forged My Husband's Name to Evict the Noisy Kids Next Door. He Picked the Wrong Night.
description:
The landlord leaned on our fence and handed my grumpy husband a noise complaint. Sign it, he said, and those screaming kids next door and their mother are out by Christmas. Earl didn't sign it. Two weeks later it came back with his signature on it anyway, stamped and notarized.

The man picked the wrong night to forge it. Stay until the award ceremony at City Hall, when I asked the councilman to listen to one phone call.
